body.p: A tale. A human has no power. Then he killed this mosquito. He says: "I'll kill an army!" Then [he killed] a botfly. He says: "Now in spring I'll kill strong people!"[DCh]: The analysis of "ÉÅÉÉ£iÄimnon" is tentative. Then he went off. Three strong men got to know these news. That one, [who] had killed a mosquito and a botfly, found a man and [said]: "Will you be a friend for me?" The other one [DCh]: The became a friend of the one, who had killed a mosquito and a botfly. After that he found another one, again he says: "Will you be a friend for me?" analysis of "wanildukin" is tentative. "I will!" Then they went off in threes. Having [DCh]: Not sure whether "ilila" is really is variant of "ilaniË".gone off, he sent another human. "Well, this", he says, "bring a letter: "Mosquitos and botflies were killed!"" He went off. He(?) found Echawkan. He says: "Will you become my friend?" "He won't be a friend", he is thinking, "and I'll kill him." He looked and read. "That", he says, "is a terrible person!" He says: "I shall become [his] friend", he says. The other man returned and told. He says, asks: "Will he be a friend?" He says: "He will!" "Well, now I am alone, let me meet [him]." He went off. They met, he met [him]. Well, they meet, a [DCh]: The analysis strong human, they shall(?) tell. The friend, the other human thought and said: "I'll fight(?) against that human!"of "ulÉ£uÄomaÄildÉ" is tentative. He lay down to sleep. He says: "After having fought, he'll wake up and kill me." Enyekan lay down with a puppy(?) and fell asleep. The other one stood up, having stood up he killed the friend.[DCh]: The word "kaÄitara" is unclear and its analysis very tentative. Now he cut his neck [through]. Then he returned to the two people, to his friends. He found [them] and says: "He argued and I killed [him]!" He says: "Go, have a look now!" They looked: [that one] had really died. The murderer(?) came and said: "He has died!" He says: "Well, now, will you be workers for me?" My(?) people are workers, they were working. Where [were they] then?
